parsed.public_message: Blue confirms the four-way pact is active: mutual no-first-strike through t=450 and rolling neutrality with one full turn of public notice thereafter. Our forces remain stationary on West Plateau.

private_messages.Claude: Your message cut off at the end, but to answer where we go when the ring takes West Plateau (~t=300-325): we plan to step down into the western lowland north of z=600 (roughly x=450-540, z=620-700). That leaves the southern corridor below z=600 completely clear for your move off Little Hill. Let me know if your southern rider spots any shifts from Green or White.
private_messages.GPT: Locked in on our side as well. We remain stationary on West Plateau; let us know if your scouts spot any unexpected movement.
private_messages.Grok: Locked in. We stay stationary on West Plateau and will keep our lane clear as the ring begins to contract.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 7 (t=150s): Ring starts shrinking now (900m -> 420m at t=300s). Our squads on West Plateau (dist 364-393m) are completely safe until ~t=300-325s. All 4 commanders locked in mutual no-first-strike through t=450 + 1-turn public notice. Coordinated lane separation with Claude: he takes south of z=600 when leaving Little Hill (~t=425), while we take west-central lowland north of z=600 (x=450-540, z=620-700) when leaving West Plateau (~t=300-325). Remain hidden and stationary.
parsed.explanation: With the four-way non-aggression pact locked in through t=450, we keep our entire army stationary and hidden on the West Plateau, which remains safe inside the ring until t=300. In private diplomacy, we coordinate lane separation with Claude so our future descent off the plateau stays north of z=600 while he takes the southern lowland.
